title: more-itertools strict counted sample exhaustion
objective: Fix counted sample() so strict=True raises ValueError whenever the requested sample is larger than the population represented by counts, including exhausted or zero-count iterators, without regressing exact-size, non-strict, weighted, or argument-validation behavior.

dependencies: standard-library unittest only; no third-party runtime dependencies

boundaries: The task replays the effective change from more-itertools pull request #944 against the merge commit's first parent; it is not an official project benchmark.
The public and hidden cases are a ReproPilot split of the upstream strict-counts regression plus explicit iterator and non-regression cases.
The pull request head and merge commit are retained as provenance for human review and are not included in candidate proposer context.
A contract pass proves the frozen cases and upstream suite passed; it does not prove semantic equivalence with the maintainer patch.
